tool.name: DecodeModel
tool.description: Evaluates a PyTorch autoencoder from the given properties.

param.name: input_model_pth_path
param.help: Path to the trained model file whose decoder will be used

param.name: input_dataset_npy_path
param.help: Path to the input latent variables file in NumPy format (e.g. encoded 'z')

param.name: outname_output_results_npz_path
param.help: Path to the output reconstructed data file (compressed NumPy archive, typically containing 'xhat')

param.name: config_json
param.label: Configuration file
param.help: File containing tool settings. See below for the syntax
